en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded grandstand in front of ornate historic buildings during a medieval-style jousting tournament. Two armored riders on horses tilt with lances in an arena separated by a long wooden barrier, while spectators fill tiered seating and flags and banners hang from poles and facades. In the foreground, costumed figures watch the event. Printed caption text and publisher information appear along the bottom margin.
